title: Add 5-star rating system, view counter, and share functionality

requirements.text: Implement a 5-star rating system on the Video Player page that allows users to rate videos from 1 to 5 stars, styled like the original 2005 YouTube star rating system

quotes: Implement a 5-Star Rating system just like the original 2005 YouTube

acceptanceCriteria: Display 5 clickable star icons on the VideoPlayer page
Clicking a star sets the rating for that video (1-5 stars)
Visual feedback shows which stars are selected
Style matches the classic 2005 YouTube aesthetic
Users can change their rating by clicking a different star

requirements.text: Store video ratings in the backend database, associating each rating with the specific video ID and user principal who submitted it

quotes: Make sure the ratings and views are saved in the database for each specific video

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores rating value (1-5) per video per user
Users can update their existing rating
Ratings persist across sessions
Backend calculates and returns average rating for each video

requirements.text: Display the average star rating and total number of ratings for each video on the Video Player page
acceptanceCriteria: Show average rating as filled/half-filled stars
Display rating count (e.g., '4.2 stars (156 ratings)')
Update display when user submits a new rating

requirements.text: Add a view counter to each video that increments every time the Video Player page is loaded for that specific video

quotes: Add a View Counter that increments every time the page is loaded

acceptanceCriteria: View count increments when VideoPlayer page loads
Backend persists view count for each video
View count displays on the Video Player page using existing formatNumber utility
Multiple page loads by the same user count as separate views

requirements.text: Add a 'Share' button on the Video Player page that copies the current video URL to the user's clipboard

quotes: Add a 'Share' button that copies the current URL to the clipboard

acceptanceCriteria: Share button is visible on the VideoPlayer page
Clicking the button copies the full video URL to clipboard
Show a toast notification confirming successful copy
Button works on all modern browsers that support clipboard API

constraints: Use the existing video data model in backend/main.mo
Maintain the existing VideoPlayer page layout and structure
Follow the YouTube-style dark theme established in the application
Use the existing useIncrementVideoView hook pattern for view counting
nonGoals: Implementing rating displays on video cards in gallery view
Adding social sharing to external platforms
Creating a 'like/dislike' system separate from stars
